most_shared_last_year.text: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk.
The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face.
As of December 31, 2020, we had an accumulated deficit of $246.0 million.
We may not prevail in any lawsuits that we initiate, and the damages or other remedies awarded, if any, may not be commercially meaningful.

Furthermore, because of the substantial amount of discovery required in connection with intellectual property litigation, there is a risk that some of our confidential information could be compromised by disclosure during this type of litigation.
If some investors find our common stock less attractive as a result, there may be a less active trading market for our common stock and our stock price may be more volatile.
Many companies have encountered significant problems in protecting and defending intellectual property rights in foreign jurisdictions.
We may not be able to protect our intellectual property rights throughout the world.
Enforcing a claim that a party illegally disclosed or misappropriated a trade secret is difficult, expensive and time- consuming, and the outcome is unpredictable.
The outcome following legal assertions of invalidity and unenforceability is unpredictable.

Accordingly, our efforts to enforce our intellectual property rights around the world may be inadequate to obtain a significant commercial advantage from the intellectual property that we develop or license.
a decreased ability to issue additional securities or obtain additional financing in the future.

examples.label: exact
examples.text: We face a wide range of risks, and our continued success depends on our ability to identify, prioritize and appropriately manage our enterprise risk exposures.
examples.previous_text: We face a wide range of risks, and our continued success depends on our ability to identify, prioritize and appropriately manage our enterprise risk exposures.

examples.label: exact
examples.text: Readers should carefully consider each of the following risks and all of the other information set forth in this Form 10-K.
examples.previous_text: Readers should carefully consider each of the following risks and all of the other information set forth in this Form 10-K.

examples.label: exact
examples.text: These risks and other factors may affect forward-looking statements, including those in this document or made by the Company elsewhere, such as in earnings release webcasts, investor conference presentations or press releases.
examples.previous_text: These risks and other factors may affect forward-looking statements, including those in this document or made by the Company elsewhere, such as in earnings release webcasts, investor conference presentations or press releases.

examples.label: near
examples.text: Recently, global markets have experienced materially higher levels of market volatility due to concerns including changes in the market’s perception of global growth, additional ECB intervention, a British exit from the European Union (EU) (Brexit), uncertainty surrounding Japan’s continued recovery amidst assorted policy changes, significant declines in global commodity prices including oil, divergent monetary policies in the United States versus many other developed economies, a newly elected U.S. president, and heightened concerns surrounding the Chinese economy.
examples.previous_text: Recently, global markets have experienced materially higher levels of market volatility due to concerns including changes in the market’s perception of global growth, additional ECB intervention, uncertainty surrounding Japan’s continued recovery amidst assorted policy changes, significant declines in global commodity prices including oil, divergent monetary policies in the United States versus many other developed economies, and heightened concerns surrounding the Chinese economy.

examples.label: near
examples.text: As we hold a significant amount of fixed maturity and perpetual securities issued by borrowers located in many different parts of the world, including a large portion issued by banks and financial institutions, sovereigns, and other corporate borrowers in the United States and Europe, our financial results are directly influenced by global financial markets.
examples.previous_text: As we hold a significant amount of fixed maturity and perpetual securities issued by borrowers located in many different parts of the world, including a large portion issued by banks and financial institutions, sovereigns, and other corporate borrowers in the U.S. and Europe, our financial results are directly influenced by global financial markets.

examples.label: near
examples.text: Following the election of Shinzo Abe as Prime Minister of Japan in December 2012, the new administration adopted a new set of financial measures to stimulate the Japanese economy, including imposing negative interest rates on excess bank reserves.
examples.previous_text: Following the election of Shinzo Abe as Prime Minister of Japan in December 2012, the new administration adopted a new set of financial measures to stimulate the Japanese economy, most recently imposing negative interest rates on excess bank reserves.

examples.text: A rise in interest rates could decrease the fair value of our debt and perpetual securities.
examples.previous_text: Conversely, a decline in interest rates could decrease the net unrealized loss position of our debt and perpetual securities.

examples.text: The investment in private placements and legacy perpetual securities carries risk associated with illiquidity, which is managed and monitored by the Company.
examples.previous_text: The investment in private placements and perpetual securities has led to increased risks associated with illiquidity.

examples.text: The financial crisis also resulted in new government regulation, including the Dodd-Frank Act.
examples.previous_text: The financial crisis also created new government regulation, including the Dodd-Frank Financial Regulatory Reform Bill for U.S. institutions.

examples.label: new
examples.text: More recently, as the Bank of Japan (BoJ) has signaled to hold its policy rate at zero, the Japan Government Bond (JGB) yield curve has steepened producing higher rates on longer maturity Japanese Government bonds.

examples.label: new
examples.text: Failure to execute or implement the conversion of the Japan branch to a legal subsidiary could adversely affect our business, results of operations, or financial position.

examples.label: new
examples.text: The implementation of the Japan Branch conversion to a legal subsidiary is a complex undertaking and involves a number of risks, including additional costs, information technology-related delays and problems, personnel loss, regulatory law changes, legal and regulatory requirements, changes to our operations, and management distraction.
